scripts.db:setup: pnpm db:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:import
scripts.ios:sync: pnpm --filter @eralens/ios probe:db && pnpm --filter @eralens/web build:ios && pnpm --filter @eralens/ios sync
scripts.ios:build:sim: xcodebuild -project apps/ios/ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .build/ios/DerivedData -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath .build/ios/SourcePackages CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
